output.summary: A large plant widespread in eastern Australia, the Queensland grasstree can develop a tall, many-branched trunk and grey or bluish-green leaves. Ngunnawal people make a sweet drink by soaking its flower spike and eat the growing leaf-stem portion and white leaf bases.
